{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for invalid values after conversion
invalid_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum() + (sales_df['revenue'] < 0).sum()
print(f"Invalid revenue values (NaN or negative): {invalid_revenue}")

# Drop rows with invalid revenue
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])
print(f"Rows after dropping invalid revenue: {len(sales_df)}")

# Now check for any remaining non-numeric characters
print("Sample of revenue values after conversion:")
print(sales_df['revenue'].head(10))"}
